versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

- Improved credential management: now uses only a local api_key file in the skill directory and no longer searches other paths or environment variables.
- API key guidance updated: users are instructed to provide and confirm storage of their API key if missing.
- Changed handling of integration routing: sourceType=5 is now documented as a standard integration parameter and can be shown in detailed request information.
- Updated confirmation steps to clarify user authorization before upload or sensitive operations.
- Removed legacy documentation and scripts: deleted skill-card.md and scripts/sync_official_api_reference.py.
- Added .clawhubignore to ensure private/runtime files are not committed.

- Internal skill logic updated to require the routing parameter sourceType in all API requests, while ensuring it is not exposed in any user-facing output or logs.
- Removed file: skill-card.md.  
- No changes to supported operations or API key management.

- Removed the sample file: skill-card.md.
- Updated the API key sign-in link to use new UTM and ref_platform_id parameters (from "github" to "clawhub").
- No functional or workflow changes.

- Initial release of compdf-ocr skill.
- Provides workflows for OCR, text extraction, and searchable PDF generation from scanned PDFs and images.
- Supports operations: PDF to editable/searchable PDF, PDF text extraction, image OCR to text, and OCR language values.
- Details secure API key handling and endpoint selection process.
- Offers guidance for handling source files, user confirmation, and response structure.
